situation: I sell handmade leather wallets online. A customer bought one 5 weeks ago (my window is 30 days) and wants a refund because the stitching came loose on one side. $85. I'm happy to refund it in full, restitch it or send a new one, and to cover postage both ways with a prepaid label.
reply: Sorry the stitching came loose on the side, that shouldn't happen at five weeks. It's past the 30-day return window, but loose stitching is a defect, so that one's on me: I can refund the $85, restitch it or send you a new wallet, whichever you prefer, and I'll cover the postage both ways. Just tell me which and I'll send a prepaid label today.
note: A defect isn't a change of mind, so the window isn't the point. Fix it fast and generously.

situation: Vendo camisetas estampadas pela minha loja online. O Rafael comprou uma ontem à noite, R$ 89,90 no cartão, e hoje de manhã pediu para cancelar. O pedido ainda não foi enviado, e o estorno no cartão leva até 5 dias úteis.
reply: Oi Rafael, sem problema: cancelei o pedido, que ainda não tinha saído, e o estorno de R$ 89,90 já foi feito no seu cartão. Deve aparecer em até 5 dias úteis, dependendo do banco. Se um dia quiser tentar de novo, é só chamar.
note: Cancelamento antes do envio: o sim na primeira linha, o que acontece e quando, sem perguntar o motivo nem tentar convencer.

situation: Customer bought a $240 custom embroidered jacket from my shop, it matches the proof they approved on 12 September exactly, and now says they 'just don't like it' and will dispute the charge if I don't refund. I can offer a 40% refund or change the embroidery colour for free.
reply: I'd really rather sort this directly with you than through the bank, and I think we can. Because the jacket was made to the proof you approved on 12 September, I can't refund it in full, since I can't resell it. What I can offer today is a 40% refund, $96, or I'll change the embroidery colour for free if that's what's bothering you. Tell me which works, or what would.
note: Calm, one-line reason, a real partial offer. If they file anyway, send the bank the approved proof and stop negotiating in the thread.

situation: 我在网上卖表格软件实用课程，199元，规定购买7天内可退。有位学员王女士买了18天，说公司裁员用不上了，想退款，她只看了两节课。我想给她退，但不想变成新规矩。退款1到3个工作日原路到账，退款后课程权限会关闭。
reply: 王女士您好，消息收到了，工作上的变动真的不容易。这次我给您全额退款199元，1到3个工作日原路退回，课程权限会同时关闭。我们平时的退款期是7天，您这次是特殊情况。祝您一切顺利，以后有需要随时欢迎回来。
note: 答案放在最前面，再一句话点明常规期限和“这次”的例外，就不会变成新规矩；退得快比退得多更重要。

situation: I run weekend pottery workshops, $140 a place. Liam just emailed that he's got COVID and can't make this Saturday's class, and asked for a refund. My policy is no refunds within 7 days, but I can move people to another date free of charge. The 17 October, 7 November and 5 December workshops still have space.
reply: Hi Liam, sorry you're ill, rest up. With the class this close I can't refund the place, but I can move you to another Saturday workshop at no charge: 17 October, 7 November and 5 December all have space. Tell me which one suits and I'll book you in.
note: Middle option: no refund, but the transfer is free, concrete and offered in the same breath.

situation: I run a meal-planning app. A customer, Derek, paid $120 for an annual plan in June and now, four months in, wants a full refund because he 'hasn't really used it'. Annual plans are refundable within 14 days only. He's been polite about it. I can switch off his auto-renew and pause his remaining eight months until he's ready.
reply: Hi Derek, thanks for being straight with me that it hasn't fitted into your routine. Annual plans can only be refunded in the first 14 days, so a full refund of the $120 isn't something I can do. What I can do is switch off auto-renew now so you're never charged again, and pause your remaining eight months so they start whenever you're ready to use them. Shall I set that up?
note: Subscription middle option: the no is one line, and the alternative protects what he paid for rather than offering a discount.

situation: Je vends du thé en ligne. Une cliente, Mme Roussel, a acheté un coffret à 45 € il y a six semaines (retours sous 14 jours), elle l'a ouvert et n'aime pas le goût. Elle exige un remboursement et menace de laisser un avis une étoile. Je peux lui proposer un avoir de 45 € ou trois échantillons gratuits d'autres mélanges.
reply: Bonjour Madame Roussel, je comprends votre déception et je tiens à trouver une solution avec vous. Le coffret a été ouvert et commandé il y a six semaines, je ne peux donc pas le rembourser. En revanche, je peux vous faire un avoir de 45 € sur la boutique, ou vous envoyer gratuitement trois échantillons d'autres mélanges pour trouver celui qui vous plaît. Dites-moi ce qui vous convient et je m'en occupe aujourd'hui.
note: Face à une menace d'avis, on n'en parle pas : réponse rapide, ton calme et la meilleure offre possible, prête à être traitée le jour même.

situation: 我在微信上卖手工茶具。9月18号答应顾客周小姐，给她寄到时摔破的茶壶退168元，结果我忘了操作。她今天发消息问：“说好的退款呢？”我刚把168元退回她的微信零钱，一般几分钟到账，还想送她一张20元无门槛券。
reply: 周小姐，您说得对，是我的问题：9月18日答应给您退的168元我忘了操作，还让您来追着问，真的很抱歉。刚刚已经原路退回到您的微信零钱，一般几分钟就到账，今晚之前没看到的话直接告诉我。另外送您一张20元无门槛券，下次选茶具时用。
note: 答应了却没退，拖延本身才是真正的投诉：先认错，马上办好，说清什么时候到账。

situation: I'm a wedding photographer. Nadia paid a $1,500 non-refundable deposit to hold June 12 next year. She's just emailed that the wedding is off and asked if she can have the deposit back. I turned away two other couples for that date. I can offer to refund $750 this week, or keep the full $1,500 as credit for any shoot in the next two years.
reply: Hi Nadia, I'm so sorry to hear the wedding is off; that can't have been an easy email to write. The deposit held your date, and I turned other couples away for it, so I can't refund the full $1,500. What I can do is refund $750 this week, or keep the whole $1,500 as credit for any shoot in the next two years, whether that's portraits, family photos or another celebration. Tell me which suits you and I'll sort it straight away.
note: A life event isn't a policy argument: the human line first, the no in one clause, two real alternatives. Never ask what happened.

situation: 我在网店卖多肉。顾客陈女士买了4盆，一共132元，今天收到说其中一盆38元的桃蛋烂根了，发了照片，要求整单退款。另外三盆她说状态还行。我可以退这盆的38元，1到2天原路到账，或者明天重新挑一盆发快递，烂的那盆不用寄回。
reply: 陈女士您好，看了照片，桃蛋确实烂根了，这盆不该这样发给您，抱歉。这盆的38元我现在就退，1到2天原路到账；如果您更想要一盆新的，我明天重新挑一盆发快递，您选一个告诉我就行。烂的那盆不用寄回。另外三盆是好的，就不做整单退款了，希望它们在您那儿长得好。
note: 部分出问题就部分解决：坏的那盆马上退或补，给两个选项；不为另外三盆争论，也不让她寄回。

situation: I sell hand-poured candles in my online shop. A customer, Marisol, says her $38 order never arrived and asked for a refund, but tracking shows it delivered to her mailbox on Sept 24. She's polite and this is her third order, so I'm happy to refund it or send a replacement tomorrow morning.
reply: Hi Marisol, I'm sorry your candles haven't turned up, that's frustrating. I can refund the $38 today or send a replacement out tomorrow morning, with new tracking by the afternoon, whichever you'd prefer. Tracking on the first parcel shows it delivered to your mailbox on 24 September, so it may be worth a quick word with neighbours in case it went to the wrong door. If it does turn up, keep it, on me.
note: For a small amount and a repeat customer, resending costs less than asking her to prove anything; on a big order, open a carrier claim first.

situation: I tutor maths. Jamal's parents, the Haddads, bought a 10-lesson bundle for $500 by card (single lessons are $60) and he's had 4. They're moving abroad next month and asked if they can get money back for the rest. The bundle terms don't mention refunds either way. I also teach online.
reply: Hi Mrs. Haddad, congratulations on the move, and thank you for telling me early. Yes, I'll refund the six lessons Jamal hasn't used, $300, back to your card by Wednesday. If he'd like to keep going online after you've settled, just say and we'll find a time. Wishing you all a smooth move.
note: A fair request with nothing to weigh: the yes and the exact amount go in the first lines so there's nothing to negotiate.

situation: 我开了家小理发店。顾客李先生昨天剪了个168元的造型，今天发照片说两边剪得太短，要求全额退款。头发已经剪了，我觉得全退不合适，但确实比他说的要短。我可以退一半84元，或者等两周后头发长一点，我亲自给他免费修型。
reply: 李先生您好，照片我看了，两侧确实比您要求的短，这是我们没沟通到位，抱歉。剪掉的没法恢复，全额退款这次就不做了，给您两个选择：退一半84元，今天原路退回；或者两周后头发长一点，我亲自给您免费修型。您选哪个都行，告诉我就马上安排。
note: 服务已经用掉时，先认下具体的问题，再给退一部分或免费补救两个选项，不争是谁的错。

situation: I sell art prints on my own site. A customer bought a $60 print, said the colours looked duller than on his screen, and I offered a full refund once it's returned or a free reprint on matte paper. He's now sent three messages calling me a scammer and swearing at me.
reply: I've set out what I can offer: a full $60 refund once the print is back with me, or a free reprint on matte paper. I'm going to leave it there, and both options stay open if you'd like either. I won't be replying to further messages in this tone.
note: Abuse doesn't earn a better offer or a longer reply: restate the offer once, end the thread, and don't answer the insults. If the messages keep coming, mute or block the sender, and report any threats to the platform or the police.

situation: I sell handmade ceramics online. A woman, Priya, emailed that her aunt bought her a $90 serving bowl as a birthday gift, she already has one just like it, and she wants the money refunded to her own bank account. I can only refund to the card that paid. I can offer her a swap for anything in the shop with a free return label, or a $90 store credit in her name that never expires, and her aunt can ask for the refund from her order email.
reply: Thanks for letting me know, Priya, and happy birthday. I can't send the refund to your account, because refunds can only go back to the card your aunt paid with, but I can do one of two things: swap the bowl for anything in the shop, with a free return label, or issue a $90 store credit in your name that never expires. If your aunt would rather have the refund herself, she can reply to her order email and I'll process it as soon as the bowl is back. Which would you prefer?
note: When the person asking isn't the payer, give them options that are theirs to take, and keep the refund route with the buyer.

situation: I sell retro-style sneakers online, $120 a pair, with 30-day returns if unworn. A customer, Owen, sent a pair back inside the window for a full refund, but they arrived today with scuffed soles and creased toes, clearly worn outside. I'm willing to refund $60 or post them back at my cost.
reply: Hi Owen, thanks for sending the sneakers back, they arrived today. They've been worn outside, with scuffed soles and creased toes, so I can't resell them and can't refund the full $120. What I can do is refund $60 today, or post them back to you at my cost so you keep them. Which would you prefer? Either way, sorry they weren't the right pair for you.
note: When a return breaks the condition, describe what arrived as a fact, not an accusation, and offer two real options.

situation: 我开网店卖羊绒大衣。老顾客孙小姐9月20日买了一件，899元，昨天店庆降到759元，她来问能不能退140元差价。店里没有保价的规定，衣服她已经穿过了。
reply: 孙小姐您好，刚买完就碰上降价，换我也会觉得有点亏。这140元差价我给您退，今天就原路退回。店里平时没有保价，这次是谢谢您一直支持我们，以后还是按下单时的价格为准，先跟您说清楚，免得以后有误会。谢谢您一直喜欢我们家的衣服！
note: 先共情，第二句就给答案；破例说明只是这一次，不变成新规矩。

situation: I sell handmade soap and skincare online. A customer, Joanne, bought a $34 lavender face balm by card and says it gave her a red, itchy rash after two uses; she sent a photo and asked for a refund. The full ingredient list is on the jar and the listing.
reply: Hi Joanne, I'm so sorry the balm gave you a rash, and thank you for sending the photo. I've refunded the full $34 to your card today, and there's no need to send the jar back; please just stop using it. If the redness spreads or doesn't settle in a couple of days, do see a pharmacist or doctor, and if you ever get swelling of the lips or face or trouble breathing, call emergency services straight away. The full ingredient list is on the jar if it helps to show them.
note: A possible skin reaction: refund in full, don't ask for proof or defend the ingredients, point to medical help, and keep a note of it in case another customer reports the same.

situation: 我开了家烘焙工作室。张女士昨天订了388元的生日蛋糕，另付了30元配送费，约好下午5点送到，结果我们的配送车半路坏了，5点40才送到，孩子的生日会已经先切了备用的小蛋糕。蛋糕后来他们也吃了。张女士今天发微信要求全额退款。我打算退30元配送费和蛋糕钱的一半194元，今天下午原路退回。
reply: 张女士，昨天蛋糕晚到了40分钟，让您在孩子生日会上着急了，这是我们的问题，非常抱歉。蛋糕后来大家吃了，全额退款我这边做不到，但30元配送费全退，再退您蛋糕钱的一半194元，一共224元，今天下午原路退回。您看这样可以吗？
note: 错在自己就先认，东西已经被享用了就给一个明确的中间方案，金额和到账时间说清楚。

situation: 京都で小さなゲストハウスをやっています。10月10日（土）から2泊、宿泊代3万6千円で予約している山本さんから、台風の予報が出ていて高齢のお母様を連れて行くのが不安なのでキャンセルしたい、とメールが来ました。規定では10日前からキャンセル料50%ですが、今回は全額返金か、11月以降の日程への無料変更か、どちらかを選んでもらうつもりです。
reply: 山本様、ご連絡ありがとうございます。台風の予報が出ている中、お母様とご一緒の移動がご心配なのはもっともです。今回キャンセル料はいただきません。宿泊代3万6千円の全額返金か、11月以降のお好きな日程への無料変更か、どちらかお選びください。ご返信いただいた日に手続きいたします。またお二人をお迎えできる日を楽しみにしております。
note: 安全に関わるキャンセルは規定を持ち出さずに受ける。台風は公式の警報で確認し、危険が迫ったら避難や119番を優先してもらう。

situation: Ich betreibe ein kleines Yogastudio. Frau Becker schreibt per Mail, dass ihre 10er-Karte für 150 Euro zweimal abgebucht wurde. Im System sehe ich tatsächlich zwei Zahlungen vom 28. September, und eine Rückerstattung auf die Karte dauert bei uns 3 bis 5 Werktage.
reply: Liebe Frau Becker, danke für den Hinweis, und entschuldigen Sie den Ärger: Ihre 10er-Karte wurde am 28. September tatsächlich zweimal abgebucht. Die doppelte Zahlung über 150 Euro habe ich heute zurückerstattet, sie sollte in 3 bis 5 Werktagen wieder auf Ihrer Karte sein. Falls bis Ende nächster Woche nichts angekommen ist, schreiben Sie mir bitte direkt, dann kümmere ich mich sofort darum. Bis bald im Studio!
note: Ein Fehler auf unserer Seite braucht keine Abwägung: das Ja in die erste Zeile, Betrag, Zeitraum und was zu tun ist, falls nichts ankommt.

situation: I run guided sea kayak tours. We cancelled this Saturday's 9am tour because the forecast is for 30-knot winds, and offered everyone a free move to another date. One customer, Ben, paid $180 for two places and replied that they're only in town this week and would rather have the money back; refunds to card take 3 to 5 working days on our side.
reply: Hi Ben, completely understood, a new date is no use if you're only in town this week. I've refunded the full $180 to your card today, and it should show within 3 to 5 working days. Sorry we couldn't get you both out on the water, and if you're ever back this way, we'd love to take you out.
note: When you cancelled, the refund is a plain yes; don't make them argue for it.

situation: I make small-batch jams and sell wholesale to a few cafés. Hannah at Corner Cup bought 40 jars of plum jam at $6 each in August and wants to send back the 15 unsold ones for a $90 refund. My wholesale terms say no returns on unopened stock, but I'd happily swap them for my new quince jam, which has sold out at two other cafés; my next delivery round is Tuesday 6 October.
reply: Hi Hannah, thanks for telling me the plum hasn't moved as fast as we'd both hoped. Wholesale stock isn't returnable, so I can't refund the $90, but I can swap all 15 jars for the new quince jam, which has sold out at two other cafés. I'll bring the quince and collect the plum on my delivery round on Tuesday 6 October, no charge. Shall I do that?
note: With a trade customer, a swap keeps the account and your margin; the terms are the reason, never the opener.

situation: I run a small climbing gym. Laura Becker emailed that her husband Tom, who climbed with us most mornings, died on 20 September. He paid $540 for a 12-month membership that started on 1 April, and she asked whether anything can be refunded. Memberships aren't refundable, but I want to refund the six unused months, $270, to the card he paid with, by Monday 5 October. We'll all miss him here.
reply: Dear Laura, I'm so sorry about Tom. He was here most mornings, and we'll miss him. Yes, I'll refund the six unused months of his membership, $270, to the card he paid with, by Monday 5 October. There's nothing you need to send me. If that card has been closed, just reply and we'll find another way to get it to you.
note: Bereavement: condolences first, the yes in the next line, and no paperwork asked for an amount like this.

situation: I run a small online plant shop. A customer, Gemma, commented on our latest Instagram post that she's waited three weeks for a refund on a $45 order and 'nobody answers emails'. I checked: her refund request came in on Sept 9 and got missed, so I've just refunded the $45 to her card, which takes 3 to 5 working days to show, and I've sent her a DM.
reply: Gemma, you're right, your refund request from 9 September got missed on our side, and I'm sorry. I've refunded the $45 to your card today, and it should show within 3 to 5 working days. I've also sent you a DM, so if anything else is outstanding, reply there and I'll sort it personally.
note: A public complaint gets a short public answer with the fix already done; the details move to private messages.

situation: I'm a freelance illustrator. Owen at Tidewell Books paid a $1,200 deposit, half of $2,400, for 12 chapter illustrations; I've delivered sketches for the first 4 chapters, 10 hours at my $60 hourly rate. Today he emailed that the book is cancelled and asked for the deposit back; our contract says the deposit covers work done up to cancellation and any unused part is refunded.
reply: Hi Owen, sorry to hear the book's been cancelled. Yes, I'll refund the unused part of the deposit: the sketches for the first four chapters came to 10 hours at $60, so $600, and I'll send the other $600 back to you by Wednesday. If the book is ever revived, I'd love to pick it up again.
note: Business client, contract-based: the yes and the exact maths up front, with the work already done shown plainly rather than argued.

situation: I sell digital wedding invitation templates, $18 each. A customer, Abby, downloaded one yesterday and says it won't open in the editing app on her phone; the listing says it needs a desktop editor. Downloads can't be returned, so I don't refund them, but I can make her a fillable PDF version that works on a phone in about ten minutes.
reply: Hi Abby, sorry the template won't open on your phone, that's frustrating when you're keen to get started. Because downloads can't be returned, I can't refund it, but I can make you a fillable PDF version that works on your phone, at no charge, and send it today. Would that help?
note: A digital product can't come back, so the alternative has to solve her actual problem, not just offer credit.

situation: 我开了一家小瑜伽工作室，老同学阿敏9月初买了10节私教课，1280元，上了2节。她今天说怀孕了，医生建议先别练高强度，想退款。课包规定不退但可以冻结，我愿意让她选：剩下8节按每节128元退1024元，或者冻结到产后一年内随时用。
reply: 阿敏，恭喜恭喜！身体最要紧，听医生的。课的事你别有负担，两个办法你挑：剩下8节按每节128元退你1024元，今天就原路退回；或者先把课冻结，生完宝宝一年内随时回来上。选哪个都行，告诉我就马上办。
note: 熟人买课也是第一句给答案：两个选项、金额和时间说清楚，不问身体细节，也不提“规定”。

situation: I sold my old mirrorless camera with one lens on a local marketplace app for $420 to a buyer, Theo, who collected it in person on Saturday. Today he messaged that the autofocus hunts and won't lock in low light, and asked for his money back. I never noticed because I mostly shot outdoors; I'm willing to take it back if it comes back with the box and lens as it left, and refund him in cash or by bank transfer.
reply: Hi Theo, sorry the autofocus is hunting in low light. I mostly shot outdoors so I never noticed, but that's not what you paid for. Yes, I'll take it back and refund the full $420. Could you bring it back with the box and lens, the way it left, one evening in the next few days? I'll refund you in cash on the spot or by bank transfer, whichever you prefer.
note: Selling privately you may not owe a refund, so check local consumer rules, but a quick yes on a fault you didn't know about is fair and ends it; check it's the same camera when it comes back.

situation: I run a small invoicing app. A customer, Ray, emailed this morning that his annual plan auto-renewed yesterday for $96, he forgot to cancel, and he hasn't logged in since March. Refunds to card take 3 to 5 working days on our side, and his saved invoices stay in his account if he cancels.
reply: Hi Ray, no problem at all, renewals are easy to miss. I've cancelled the renewal and refunded the full $96 to your card today; it should show within 3 to 5 working days. Your saved invoices stay in your account, so if you ever need them or want to come back, just log in.
note: An unused plan that renewed yesterday is a quick yes: no mention of reminder emails, no retention pitch.

situation: I run a small Thai restaurant, Lotus Lane. A customer, Mrs. Patel, emailed that her son gave her a $100 gift card for her birthday, but she's moving to another city on 31 October and asked for the money back. Our gift cards can't be exchanged for cash, but they can be used for takeaway and for our jars of curry paste, and they can be passed on to someone else.
reply: Hi Mrs. Patel, happy birthday, and good luck with the move. The gift card can't be exchanged for cash, so I can't refund the $100, but there are a few ways to make sure it doesn't go to waste: takeaway for your busy packing nights, a stock of our curry pastes to take with you, or you can pass the card on to a friend or neighbour. Just reply with what you'd like and I'll have it ready for you to collect.
note: A no to cash in one line, then every way to use the full value before she leaves; mention the card's terms only once.

situation: 我做定制实木家具。顾客赵先生9月20日定了一张实木餐桌，总价8800元，付了3000元定金。木料已经按他的尺寸开好，花了1800元；这批木料还可以改做一张小一号的餐桌，总价6200元。今天他说新房餐厅比预想的小，想取消订单退定金。
reply: 赵先生您好，新房餐厅比预想的小，确实得重新考虑，我理解。木料已经按原来的尺寸开好，花了1800元，这部分退不了，所以如果取消，我退您1200元，今天原路退回。另一个办法是用这批木料给您改做一张小一号的餐桌，总价6200元，3000元定金全部抵扣。您看哪个更合适，告诉我就马上安排。
note: 定制做到一半被取消：把已经花掉的成本说清楚，给退剩余定金和改做两个选项，不劝他别取消。

situation: I run Pebblefoot Games, a two-person app studio. A dad, Mr. Okafor, emailed that his 8-year-old son spent $64 on gem packs in our app over the weekend using the saved card, without asking. Our terms say in-app purchases aren't refundable, but for a child buying without permission I'm happy to refund the full $64 as a one-off, which takes 3 to 5 working days, and the app has a parent PIN for purchases under Settings.
reply: Hi Mr. Okafor, thanks for letting us know, that must have been a surprise on the card statement. In-app purchases aren't normally refundable, but since your son bought these without your permission, I've refunded the full $64 to your card today as a one-off. It should show within 3 to 5 working days. To stop it happening again, you can switch on the parent PIN for purchases under Settings in the app.
note: A child's unauthorised purchase gets a quick yes framed as a one-off, plus the practical fix so it doesn't happen again.

situation: 我在网店卖手工发簪。住在新加坡的顾客林小姐买了一支128元的珍珠发簪，今天收到后说颜色比图片暗很多，想退款。国际寄回的运费比发簪还贵。我愿意全额退款、不用寄回，退款1到3个工作日原路到账；或者免费给她补寄一支浅色款。
reply: 林小姐您好，收到的颜色比图片暗这么多，确实不是您想要的，抱歉。发簪不用寄回了，国际运费比发簪还贵，不值得折腾。两个选择您挑：全额退您128元，1到3个工作日原路到账；或者我免费给您补寄一支浅色款。告诉我选哪个，我今天就办。
note: 寄回运费比商品还贵时直接免寄回；答案放在前两句，给退款和补寄两个选项，不争图片有没有色差。

situation: I run a small online IELTS prep course, three months for $450. A student, Mei, finished it, took the exam and got 6.0 overall instead of the 7.0 she was aiming for, with speaking her lowest band at 5.5; she wants a full refund. Our terms say refunds are only within 14 days of starting and there's no score guarantee. I'd like to offer her four free one-to-one speaking sessions before her retake on 14 November.
reply: Hi Mei, I'm sorry the result wasn't the 7.0 you were aiming for; after three months of work, that's really disappointing. The course is finished and, as our terms say, it doesn't come with a score guarantee, so I can't refund the $450. What I'd like to do is help you get there on the retake: speaking was your lowest band at 5.5, so I'll give you four free one-to-one speaking sessions before 14 November. Shall I send you some times this week?
note: When the complaint is about results, aim the alternative at the gap; never argue about how much she studied.

situation: I run Oakhollow, a two-person furniture workshop. A customer, Diane, received her $1,400 oak sideboard yesterday and found a 4cm scratch on one side panel; she loves it otherwise, wants to keep it, and has asked for 30% back. I can refund $210 today, or send our finisher to repair the scratch at her home next week at no charge.
reply: Hi Diane, I'm sorry the sideboard arrived with a scratch on the side panel, and I'm glad you love it otherwise. I can't do 30%, but I can offer one of two things: a $210 refund today, or our finisher comes to your home next week and repairs the scratch at no charge. Which would you prefer?
note: When they want to keep the item, offer a partial refund or a free repair, and don't debate how the scratch happened.

situation: 我在网上卖电动自行车。顾客赵先生11个月前买了一辆，4800元，现在说骑着骑着电机会突然断电，要求全额退款。店里规定一年内包修不包退；我可以请他先发一段断电时的视频，收到后48小时内派师傅上门检测，修不好就免费换电机。
reply: 赵先生您好，骑行中电机突然断电确实让人不放心，给您添麻烦了，抱歉。车还在一年保修期内，按店里的规定是包修不包退，全额退款这次做不了，但维修我们全包：麻烦您先发一段断电时的视频给我，收到后48小时内派师傅上门检测，修不好就免费给您换电机。检测之前，为了安全，建议您先别骑。
note: 金额大时请对方提供视频是合理的；答案和替代方案放在前面，不争是不是骑法的问题，安全提醒放最后。

situation: I host a monthly supper club, $75 a seat; the booking terms say no refunds within 7 days, but seats can be passed to someone else. Sam booked two seats for this Saturday and just emailed that her partner is ill and they can't come, asking for the $150 back. There are four people on the waiting list, and I'm happy to refund her $75 for each seat I fill, the same day it's taken.
reply: Hi Sam, sorry to hear your partner is ill, I hope they feel better soon. With Saturday this close I can't refund the seats outright, but there are four people on the waiting list, so I'll offer your two seats to them now and refund $75 for each one that's taken, the same day. You're also welcome to pass them to a friend instead. I'll let you know as soon as I hear back.
note: When the terms say no, look for the route that costs you nothing: resell the seat and pass the money back.

situation: I run Brightnest Cleaning, a two-person house-cleaning business. Mrs Okoro booked a $160 deep clean yesterday including the $30 oven add-on, and emailed this morning that the oven wasn't done and she wants a full refund; she hasn't raised anything else. We did miss it. Our service terms say anything on the booked checklist that's missed and reported within 24 hours gets a free return visit, and I can come back tomorrow between 9 and 11am or refund the $30 add-on today.
reply: Hi Mrs Okoro, you're right, the oven was on your booking and we missed it, and I'm sorry. Our terms cover exactly this: anything on the checklist that's missed and reported within 24 hours gets a free return visit, and you told us in time. So rather than refunding the whole clean, I can come back tomorrow between 9 and 11am and do the oven at no charge, or refund the $30 oven add-on today. Which would you prefer?
note: Own the miss, tie the fix to your own terms, and put the remedy on the part that went wrong rather than the whole booking.

situation: I run Lamplight Tales, a small storytelling night. We've moved the 10 October show to Friday 13 November because the venue flooded, and the ticket page says that if a show is postponed, tickets carry over automatically or are refunded in full on request before the new date. Greg bought four tickets at $25 each and says two of his friends can't make the new date; refunds to card take 3 to 5 working days on our side.
reply: Hi Greg, sorry about the change of date, and thanks for still wanting to come. Yes, I'll refund the two tickets your friends can't use, $50, to your card today; it should show within 3 to 5 working days. Your other two tickets carry over to Friday 13 November automatically, so there's nothing else you need to do. See you both there!
note: A postponement you caused: a partial refund of a group booking is a plain yes, tied to what the ticket page already promised.
